'''Security hangars''' were buildings used by the [[Royal Naboo Security Forces/Legends|Royal Naboo Security Forces]]<ref name="BFN" /> as of [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]].<ref name="The New Essential Chronology">''Battle for Naboo'' itself refers to its events taking place during the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]]. ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' establishes that the invasion happens in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]].</ref> They were capable of holding [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]], ground [[Speeder/Legends|speeders]], or if placed on [[Water/Legends|water]], aquatic vehicles. One was located in the [[Naboo airbase]] and another was located near the [[N-1 assembly site]]. The [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Ferentina]] featured a hangar that was on the water, allowing [[Naboo houseboat|houseboats]] to dock. Others were placed throughout [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]], including in the countryside near [[Theed/Legends|Theed]] and near the northern mountains. During the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation's]] [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|invasion]], another of the security hangars was found inside [[Camp Four/Legends|Camp Four]]. [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Gavyn Sykes/Legends|Gavyn Sykes]] of the Security Force used the hangars to change vehicles during the [[Naboo Resistance|resistance movement]].<ref name="BFN" />

Another hangar was near a [[Trade Federation Research Station]].<ref name="BFN" />

==Behind the scenes==
Security hangars appear in the [[2000]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Episode I: Battle for Naboo]]''. The player, in the guise of Sykes, docks at hangars in cutscenes or has the option of doing so in missions.
